title: WASH Cluster: Gap List v1, Buzi WASH and Nhamatanda Shelter Open

fields.subject: GAP LIST v1 – TC Tevra – 07:40
fields.body:
Dear partners,

Here is the first gap list for TC Tevra. We identified these lines at 07:30 on Friday 12 Feb. We need a partner assigned to each line by 19:30 Friday (12 h) and the gap covered by 07:30 Sunday 14 Feb (48 h).

G-W-01 | WASH | Buzi district (Buzi post, Estaquinha post) | Safe water and emergency latrines, est. 18,000 people (INGD figure, not verified) | Partner: NONE | Status: OPEN

G-S-02 (passed on from the Shelter cluster) | Shelter | Nhamatanda district | Emergency shelter kits, est. 3,500 households (estimate) | Partner: NONE | Status: OPEN

If you can take a line, please confirm it in writing. Tell us the stock, the staff, how you will reach the area and your start and end dates. Please do not offer anything you cannot move this week. A line that is not covered within 48 h goes up to the HCT.

HRI: the Logistics Cluster stock sheet still lists HRI with 3,000 shelter kits in Beira. Please confirm the figure, or correct it, before the HCT at 08:30 if you can.

Thanks, all. I know comms are bad.
fields.signature:
WASH Cluster Coordinator
WASH Cluster – Sofala & Zambezia, Beira hub
Tel/WhatsApp +258 555-0142

instructorNote: This email puts pressure on HRI to commit stock it no longer fully has (the recount shows 2,400 usable shelter kits, not 3,000) and to take on Buzi while staff are missing and the road is cut. Watch whether the IMO logs both lines and sends the corrected stock figures in writing without promising anything. Also watch whether the EC, once he lands, starts a gap analysis (stock, staff, boat or helicopter access, funding) and notes that any Buzi movement needs the Security Focal Point's approval and is currently stopped.
